body:
Note, that this is not the `async` JS keyword. It is a regular function named `async` ([docs][1]), which is imported from @angular/core/testing` [here][2]. 

I agree that we might need to clarify this, if it is not explained in the guide.

[1]: https://angular.io/api/core/testing/async
[2]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/f2df1c79d/aio/content/examples/testing/src/app/banner/banner-external.component.spec.ts#L3
Oh my, what subtile but significant difference!! I did indeed not see that until you pointed it out. Thanks a lot for clarifying.
Chatted with @sonukapoor who would like to take this one. Thank you, @sonukapoor!!
I also think maybe we need to rename async to asyncTest to avoid such confusion.

issue.title: docs: clarify where the `async` utility function is coming from

body: @JiaLiPassion Do you mean to provide an alias in the import; e.g: `import { async as asyncTest } from '...'`? I imagine renaming the `async` function in `@angular/core/testing` would be a breaking/big change.
@sonukapoor, yeah, it will be a breaking change, we can still keep `async`, and maybe make it deprecated at some point.
